articles.summary: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

articles.summary: Siggy has raised $6 million in pre-seed funding to build a mental health service that uses AI to collect patients’ histories and track progress between appointments with licensed clinicians, the startup told Crunchbase News exclusively.

articles.summary: Dropbox has announced plans to acquire Tigris Data for $350 million in a transaction the company told Crunchbase News would mark its largest acquisition since its founding in 2007.

articles.title: Sector Snapshot: Construction Robotics Funding Soars To $1.6B, Tripling Previous Peak
articles.summary: Companies spanning construction and robotics have raised about $1.6 billion so far this year  — more than 4x the $389 million recorded in all of 2025 — according to Crunchbase data. The surge was driven by three companies that raised the majority of the funding.
